features.name: distinct_url_domains_in_oc
features.definition: How many distinct URL domains are cited across all counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings; if missing or malformed return null; empty list gives 0. For each comment extract URLs with regex r'https?://[^\s)\]>"]+|www\.[^\s)\]>"]+'. Take hostname (lowercase, strip leading 'www.', port, and trailing punctuation). Return the number of unique hostnames across all comments. Raw mechanical count, no semantic filtering.

h0: distinct_url_domains_in_oc has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Greater distinct_url_domains_in_oc is associated with a higher probability of delta.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as the delta outcome (OP view change). Association only, not causal. Counts domains across all supplied counter-argument comments (OC_comments); the list is unordered with no timing, and may include comments after or announcing the outcome. Raw URL text is not outcome-free. Total URL domain count, not per comment; number of comments is not controlled.
